items.title: Senior Software Engineer at Workpay
items.description: Lead mobile development of a client-facing Expo / React Native app with 10,000+ MAU and manage a 3-person mobile team. Built GitHub Actions + Fastlane CI/CD for Android and iOS, Maestro E2E tests on BrowserStack, and NestJS auth features (JWT with Redis token revocation, Keycloak SSO). Integrated Segment, Firebase and Sentry, cutting mean time to detect issues by ~40%.
